scope: Post hoc descriptive follow-up on all 4500 previously evaluated confirmatory questions; not a new independent confirmation.
conditions: Both readers: seed, repeated full20, deduplicated full20 at b0; linked, window, no_first_priority, seed_only, rerank at b128/256/512.
original_primary: Preserve V27 primary estimate, interval and test unchanged. Replayed anchors quantify operational answer variation and provide within-run comparisons for added conditions.
unique20: Retain the first occurrence of each corpus passage ID, in original retrieval-slot order. Assert repeated ID has identical title/text; no semantic deduplication or title/identifier shortening.
rerank: Descending archived BGE score of the slot from its original retrieval subquery; ties by proximity to a seed segment within slot, slot index, segment index. Retain seed, add whole frozen regex segments under full native cap. No new reranker calls, segment-specific scores, calibration or gold use.
ablations: Unchanged V26 no_first_priority and seed_only, with unchanged V24 invalid-seed fallback.
controls: Copy original seed/full20/linked/window prompts exactly. Rerun all18conditions for a reader/question on one assigned replica with original revisions/bfloat16/max96/temperature0/seed42. Preserve two original upstream failures in denominator.
inference: All162000records completed before efficacy analysis. Three attempts only for failed operational calls; valid wrong or length-stopped outputs retained.
analysis: Descriptive question-paired stratified bootstrap intervals, 10000draws seed20261111, equal datasets. Report all budgets/readers, no favorable selection. Existing-data allowance/dataset and Hotpot difficulty analyses explicitly post hoc; no claim of subgroup confirmation.
diagnostics: Native-cap input coverage for4500questions; title/identifier token decomposition with specified order and boundary interactions; exact repeated corpus-segment additions; Hotpot level distribution; preliminary execution disagreement; anonymous public commit access.
limitations: MuSiQue provides supporting paragraphs, not gold sentence indices: report gold title presence and paragraph-aligned selected-text overlap separately, never label paragraph coverage sentence recall. No end-to-end compute-saving claim.
